# Blockfrost OpenAPI fixture

`openapi-v0.1.93.yaml` is the upstream Blockfrost OpenAPI specification at
tag `v0.1.93`, commit `3eb8b2e881b90a85121c6e3502cb65a461972ba8`:

<https://github.com/blockfrost/openapi/blob/3eb8b2e881b90a85121c6e3502cb65a461972ba8/openapi.yaml>

The upstream document declares the MIT license. The pinned copy keeps route,
parameter, response, and schema compatibility checks deterministic.
